summary: @ornikar/slate-react-fork preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated Bun bundle
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') with mangled identifiers and a large numeric constant array feeding a runtime string decoder — its behavior is not readable and it is not required by any legitimate slate-react fork. Fetching a second language runtime to execute local obfuscated code during npm install evades Node-based scanners and gives the author install-time code execution on the installer's machine. The package is published under the @ornikar scope but its repository field points at git://github.com/CorentinAndre/slate.git, an unrelated personal fork — the scope name impersonates the Ornikar organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
